info.title: EBSCO HoldingsIQ
info.description: The EBSCO HoldingsIQ service retrieves vendor, package and title related information in JSON format.  The information includes customer selected resources as reflected in the EBSCO Knowledge Base for both EBSCO managed and customer managed resources.

x-change-notes: This file is a focused excerpt for the three v2 title endpoints affected by the FOLIO simplified-contract story. It intentionally shows ONLY the paths and schemas that changed or that the changed schemas reference, so the diff is easy to review. Every other path and schema in the full working spec (vendors, packages, holdings, exports, categories, subjects, labels/proxies, and the untouched v0 title endpoints) is unchanged and is not reproduced here to keep this reviewable. Merge these blocks into the full spec at the matching paths/schemas.

get.description:
This operation allows you to search and retrieve a list of titles from EPKB regardless of the package(s) that the titles are a part of. Results are returned title-level: each title is a single object, with its associated customer resources (package associations) nested underneath. Each nested customer resource carries visibility broken out by Publication Finder (PF), Full Text Finder (FTF), and MARC, rather than a single hidden/reason flag. The response will reflect the context of the EBSCO customer ID included in the request. For a flattened, per-location result set instead, see GET /v2/{custid}/titles/{kbid} or GET /v2/{custid}/lists/{listid}/titles.

  **Please Note:**  You will need an API key to gain access to the API through our interactive documentation. If you require an API key, please contact EBSCO customer support.

parameters.name: custid
parameters.description: EBSCO Customer ID

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search Term.  Keyword search that is applied to limit the results to titles that have the search term in the search field.  Special characters in the search term need to be URL encoded.  Ex: A&G encodes to A%26G.  The Swagger Explorer performs the search parameter encoding for the **Try it out!**.

parameters.name: searchfield
parameters.description: Field to search.  Both integer and string are supported.  Valid values are titlename, publisher, isxn, subject and zdbid.  It is also valid to use 0 for title name, 1 for publisher, 2 for isxn, 3 for subject or 4 for zdbid.

parameters.name: selection
parameters.description: Limits the results.  Valid values are all, selected, notselected and orderedthroughebsco.  It is also valid to use 0 for all, 1 for selected, 2 for notselected, or 3 for ordered through EBSCO.  When you filter by all(0), the total results count takes selected and not selected into consideration.

parameters.name: resourcetype
parameters.description: Type of resource. Valid values are all, journal, newsletter, report, proceedings, website, newspaper, unspecified, book, bookseries, database, thesisdissertation, streamingaudio, streamingvideo, and audiobook.  It is also valid to use 0 for all, 1 for journal, 2 for newsletter, 3 for report, 4 for proceedings, 5 for website, 6 for newspaper, 7 for unspecified, 8 for book, 9 for book series, 10 for database, 11 for thesis dissertation, 12 for streaming audio, 13 for streaming video, or 14 for audio book.

parameters.name: searchtype
parameters.description: Type of search. Search types are any, contains, exactmatch, beginswith, proximity, exactphrase and advanced. It is also valid to use 0 for any, 1 for contains, 2 for exactmatch, 3 for beginswith, 4 for proximity, 5 for exactphrase or 6 for advanced.  searchtype is an optional parameter and defaults to contains if not provided.

parameters.name: packageidfilter
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of package ID(s). Limits the results by package ID(s). The packageidfilter is an optional parameter.

parameters.name: orderby
parameters.description: Valid values are relevance or titlename.  Default is relevance.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return in the response.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Page Offset.  Starts at 1.

parameters.name: packagefreeaccess
parameters.description: Limits the results based on Package Free Access. The filter options are (true, false, all), and the default is all.

parameters.name: subjects
parameters.description: Types of subjects to be returned. By default returns tli and bisac. Valid values are: bisac, tli, libraryofcongress and medical.

parameters.name: consortia
parameters.description: Filters title search by given consortia values. If multiple consortia names are given, documents containing any of the given consortias will be returned. Accepts consortia names or no_consortia.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Unique code assigned by EBSCO to grant you access to this API.  The API key needs to be a header parameter for every operation in order to access this API. You will need an API key to use the interactive documentation.  If you require an API key, please contact EBSCO customer support.

200.description: Title-level list of titles regardless of package, with nested customer resources and PF/FTF/MARC visibility, and the total number of results found.

get.summary: Get Title Details Regardless of Package
get.description:
This operation allows you to retrieve details for a particular title from EPKB regardless of the package that it is a part of. The response is title-level: a single title object, with its associated customer resources (package associations) nested underneath, and each nested customer resource carrying visibility broken out by Publication Finder (PF), Full Text Finder (FTF), and MARC. The response will reflect the context of the EBSCO customer ID included in the request.

  **Please Note:**  You will need an API key to gain access to the API through our interactive documentation. If you require an API key, please contact EBSCO customer support.

parameters.name: custid
parameters.description: EBSCO Customer ID

parameters.name: kbid
parameters.description: KBID

parameters.name: subjects
parameters.description: Types of subjects to be returned. By default returns tli and bisac. Valid values are: bisac, tli, libraryofcongress and medical.

parameters.name: includerelationships
parameters.description: Determines whether or not title relationship information will be returned. The possible values are 'true' or 'false'. The default behavior when this parameter is not present is to not return relationship information.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Unique code assigned by EBSCO to grant you access to this API.  The API key needs to be a header parameter for every operation in order to access this API. You will need an API key to use the interactive documentation.  If you require an API key, please contact EBSCO customer support.

200.description: Title details, regardless of package, title-level with nested customer resources and PF/FTF/MARC visibility.

get.description:
This operation allows you to perform an advanced search on titles within a list by search term with various filtering options and search strategies. Results are returned title-level: each title is a single object, with its associated customer resources (package associations for this list) nested underneath, and each nested customer resource carrying visibility broken out by Publication Finder (PF), Full Text Finder (FTF), and MARC.

  **Please Note:**  You will need an API key to gain access to the API through our interactive documentation. If you require an API key, please contact EBSCO customer support.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return in the response. Default is 10

parameters.name: custid
parameters.description: EBSCO Customer ID

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Page Offset

parameters.name: orderby
parameters.description: Valid values are relevance or titlename. Default is relevance.

parameters.name: packagefreeaccess
parameters.description: Limits the results based on Package Free Access. The filter options are (true, false, all), and the default is all.

parameters.name: resourcetype
parameters.description: Type of resource. Valid values are all, journal, newsletter, report, proceedings, website, newspaper, unspecified, book, bookseries, database, thesisdissertation, streamingaudio, streamingvideo, and audiobook.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search Term - When searching for titles without a titlesearchservice parameter, sort options will be by title name. When the titlesearchservice parameter is not null, the default sort is by relevance.

parameters.name: searchfield
parameters.description: Field to titlesearchservice. Valid values are titlename, publisher, isxn, subject, and zdbid.

parameters.name: selection

parameters.name: listid
parameters.description: List ID

parameters.name: subjects
parameters.description: Types of subjects to be returned. By default returns tli and bisac. Valid values are: bisac, tli, libraryofcongress and medical.

200.description: Title-level list of titles within the specified list, with nested customer resources and PF/FTF/MARC visibility, and the total number of results found.

titlesV2.description: Title-level list of titles regardless of package, from EPKB, and the total number of results found. Each title carries its nested customer resources with PF/FTF/MARC visibility. This is the v2 counterpart of the v0 'titles' wrapper, updated to the current (title-level, multi-category visibility) contract.

isTitleCustom.description: Is this a custom title owned by the customer.

titleRelationships.description: Title relationships (e.g. ABSORBED_BY, CONTINUED_BY, PARENT_OF) for this title. Populated only when includerelationships=true was passed on the request. Not applicable to search results.

titleDetailsV2.description: This object represents data elements that describe a title, regardless of package, in the v2 contract. It is the v2 counterpart of the v0 'titleDetails' schema: same title-level shape, with customerResourcesList items updated to carry PF/FTF/MARC visibility instead of a single isHidden/reason flag.

packageId.description: EBSCO KB's unique identifier for the package.  In EPKB, this is 'PkgID'.

packageName.description: Name of the Package. In EPKB, this is 'PkgName'.
packageName.example: Health & Wellness Resource Center (w/alt health module)

packageType.description: Package Type. Valid values are Selectable, Complete, Variable and Custom.

vendorId.description: EBSCO KB's unique identifier for the provider.  In EPKB, this is 'VendorID'.

vendorName.description: Provider name.  In EPKB, this is the 'VendorName'.

isSelected.description: Indicates if selected in a customer's account.

isTokenNeeded.description: Field to indicate if a token is needed

visibility.description: Visibility details for PF, FTF and MARC.

selectedBy.description: The resource last selected by EBSCO or the customer.

customerResourcesV2.description: This object represents data elements that describe customer resources information for a title, regardless of package, in the v2 contract. It is the v2 counterpart of the v0 'customerResources' schema, with 'visibilityData' (single isHidden/reason) replaced by 'visibility' (an array covering PF, FTF and MARC individually).

titlesPackageId.description: List of titles within a specified list/package from EPKB and the total number of results found. Unchanged in shape from v0's equivalent wrapper; only the nested customerResourcesPackageId items were updated to the PF/FTF/MARC visibility model.

isTitleCustom.description: Is this a custom title owned by the customer.

pubType.description: Type of publication. Valid values are journal, newsletter, report, proceedings, website, newspaper, unspecified, book, bookseries, database, thesisdissertation, streamingaudio, streamingvideo, and audiobook.

titlePackageId.description: This object represents data elements that describe a title within a specified list/package. Unchanged from v0's 'titlePackageId'.

packageId.description: EBSCO KB's unique identifier for the package.  In EPKB, this is 'PkgID'.

packageName.description: Name of the Package. In EPKB, this is 'PkgName'.

packageType.description: Package Type. Valid values are Selectable, Complete, Variable and Custom.

vendorId.description: EBSCO KB's unique identifier for the provider.  In EPKB, this is 'VendorID'.

vendorName.description: Provider name.  In EPKB, this is the 'VendorName'.

isTokenNeeded.description: Field to indicate if a token is needed

isSelected.description: Indicates if selected in a customer's account.

visibility.description: Visibility details for PF, FTF and MARC.

selectedBy.description: The resource last selected by EBSCO or the customer.

customerResourcesPackageId.description: This object represents data elements that describe customer resources information for a title within a specified list/package. Field-for-field identical to v0's 'customerResourcesPackageId' except 'visibilityData' (single isHidden/reason) has been replaced with 'visibility' (an array covering PF, FTF and MARC individually), matching the model already used elsewhere in v2.

type.description: The type of subject.  Valid values are BISAC and TLI.

titleType.description: Title Type. Valid values are Variant, Alternate, Proper, Former, Translated or Abbreviated.

type.description: Type of contributor. Valid values are Author, Illustrator, and Editor.

embargoUnit.description: The unit of time to use for the embargo - Days, Weeks, Months or Years.

embargoValue.description: The embargo value (number of embargoUnits).  A Null value means there is no embargo.

proxiedUrl.description: The URL to the provider's resource with the addition of the customer's proxy information.
